newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's May inflation rises 0.19 percent.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's May inflation rises 0.19 percent.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index rose 0.19 percent month-on-month in May, compared with an increase of 0.56 percent in April, a government official said on Wednesday.
The official said inflation in May was 0.19 percent.
Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent in calender 1996 against 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year that started on April 1.
